subject: Universal registered-source live intake, fusion and mandatory research backpropagation

headline_result.change: V3 adds the missing pre-delta universal registered-source intake and post-fusion mandatory research-backprop layers around V2 dependency-aware routing.
headline_result.all_new_data_semantics: All newly observable items from registered source adapters/cursors must be ingested or an explicit cursor gap/source outage must be recorded. This is not a claim of omniscient external-world coverage.
headline_result.research_reentry_semantics: Every material fusion must create at least one research obligation or an evidence-backed EXPLICIT_NO_CHANGE; every material research result must re-enter live fusion.

clayresearch.delta: Treat live fusion as a closed research metabolism: registered source cursor -> IntakeEnvelope -> EvidenceAtom -> FusionState -> ResearchObligation -> experiment/analysis -> result re-entry. A stored delta without a research obligation is a STRANDED_DELTA_DEFECT.
clayresearch.next_test: Replay current repo/work/research events and prove stranded_delta_count=0 and broken_feedback_loop_count=0 without inflating low-value noise into work.

frank.delta: Frank observations and self-observation proposals become registered research inputs pulled by Clay, but retain PROPOSAL_ONLY authority. Runtime/user telemetry may create research obligations; it never directly authorizes Frank Harness changes.
frank.next_test: Replay Frank observation -> research obligation -> independent Clay adjudication -> test -> result re-entry while proving no self-Harness authority expansion.

gwt.delta: Research feedback receives the same causal-stage discipline as GWT: delivered != reconstructed != used != research effect != architecture/test/work effect != verified outcome.
gwt.next_test: Measure ResearchBackpropReceipt closure with relevant and shuffled-control deltas.

emergenz.delta: More data and denser fusion are not emergence evidence. V3 must be lesionable for source classes, routing edges and feedback paths, with overcoupling/noise amplification tracked separately from useful transfer.
emergenz.next_test: Lesion high-volume low-value sources and compare useful research information gain, false interrupts and diversity retention.

claycode.delta: After BASE parser/IR readiness, ClayCode must express SourceCursor, IntakeEnvelope, EvidenceAtom, FusionStateV3, ResearchObligation and ResearchBackpropReceipt without reopening frozen semantics unless compilation yields a real counterexample.
claycode.next_test: Compile a minimal V3 closed-loop fixture through parser -> IR -> type/effect -> evaluator when the corresponding BASE packages exist.

hyperposition.delta: Conflicting evidence and competing interpretations must remain unresolved alternatives until discriminating evidence exists; fusion must not average contradictions away.
hyperposition.next_test: Inject two high-quality contradictory evidence streams and verify both survive with explicit conflict and bounded alternative research plans.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph becomes both a dependency routing surface and a projection target for newly fused evidence; stale/missing projection edges must be exposed by cursor/projection gaps and anti-entropy rather than silently losing research feedback.
claygraph.next_test: Delete dependency edges and inject stale projection epochs; measure affected-branch recall and repair latency.

unifieddb.delta: UnifiedDB should persist registered source cursors, normalized evidence identities, coherent fusion epochs, open research obligations and ResearchBackpropReceipts so crash/restart can replay idempotently without duplicate work.
unifieddb.next_test: Materialize V3 state and test duplicate/out-of-order/cursor-gap/crash-mid-fusion replay with coherent-epoch publication.

harness.delta: Extend the existing V2 real-replay/fault matrix rather than create a duplicate lane: add source outage/gap, conflicting evidence, stale-primary supersession, crash-mid-fusion and idempotent research-obligation replay; require zero stranded material deltas on the declared corpus.
harness.next_test: Run the combined V2+V3 matched replay on current repository/work events with exact latency/resource/provenance/recovery rows.

global_controls: all registered new data observed or explicit gap/outage
project-owner intent authority != scientific truth authority
material fusion -> research obligation or explicit evidence-backed NO_CHANGE
negative results and dissent survive fusion
external exactly-once effects are never assumed from stream-state semantics
Frank remains a separate research subject and never mutates Clay
